lines: 1. ResumeTailor AI — AI-Powered, ATS-Safe Resume Customization Engine Jun 2026 – Jul 2026
Python, FastAPI, Google Gemini API, WeasyPrint, Jinja2 | GitHub: github.com/Iamgokul7/ResumeTailor-AI | Live: resume-
tailorj5zl.onrender.com
• Architected and built a full-stack, closed-loop AI resume tailoring engine enforcing strict traceability, ensuring the LLM can only
rephrase/select from a candidate's verified master content bank and never fabricate skills, credentials, or experience.
• Designed an end-to-end pipeline: resume/JD upload → text extraction (pypdf/python-docx) → Gemini-based keyword and
JDmatch analysis → user-driven keyword selection → AI-customized rewrite of summary, skills, projects, and internships.
• Built an automated fabrication safety gate that tokenizes AI-generated output against a flattened master keyword bank, flagging
any unrecognized/unverified technology terms as an amber warning badge before the resume is finalized.
• Implemented a resilient AI service layer with an automatic model failover chain to maintain uptime against rate limits and
transient API errors.
• Engineered a paged PDF rendering pipeline using WeasyPrint with a Jinja2 templating layer (two-column and ATS-safe
singlecolumn templates), including a graceful fallback to xhtml2pdf when GTK3 dependencies are unavailable.
• Built session-based authentication with signed cookies (Starlette/itsdangerous), custom middleware route guarding for all API
endpoints, and IP-based rate limiting with lockout after repeated failed login attempts.
• Deployed the application live on Render, making it accessible as a fully functional hosted web app.
• Currently debugging and hardening the system: improving fabrication-check coverage across more violation types, updating a
deprecated Gemini model reference in the JD match-scoring path, and fixing PDF hyperlink annotation rendering for full
clickability.
2. ERPilot AI — Multi-Tenant Enterprise Resource Planning SaaS Platform Mar 2026 – May 2026
Python, Flask, SQLite, Docker, Gemini API | github.com/Iamgokul7/ERPilot-AI
• Architected and built a complete, AI-powered ERP SaaS platform end-to-end, covering employee management (HR), inventory
tracking (Materials Management), supplier management, sales order processing (Sales & Distribution), notifications, and
business reporting — directly analogous to core SAP HCM, MM, and SD module functions.
• Implemented multi-tenant architecture with tenant_id-based data isolation across a 7-table relational schema, securely
supporting unlimited tenants on a single deployment, and systematically tested access boundaries across multiple tenant
accounts to confirm correct data isolation.
• Built and audited role-based access control (RBAC) and authentication workflows from first principles, defining and verifying
permission tiers across all 7 functional modules to prevent unauthorized cross-tenant data access.
• Designed and implemented REST-based backend modules in Flask for every core business function, manually testing API
endpoints across iterations to identify and resolve access-control and data-integrity defects before each release.
• Wrote SQL queries using joins and aggregations to extract, filter, and validate data across modules, and built a business reporting
module aggregating raw transactional data into decision-ready summary views.
• Integrated the Gemini API to power a context-aware AI assistant for natural-language business queries, with logging and review
of every AI interaction to catch anomalous behavior.
• Containerized the full application with Docker and configured a production-ready deployment path using Gunicorn, considering
deployment hardening and attack surface.
3. Enhanced Security Framework: Graphical Password Authentication with Data Hiding on Cloud Storage — Final Year
Project (Published Research) Jan 2025 – May 2025
Python, Flask, OpenCV, AES Encryption, DWT Steganography, SQLite | github.com/Iamgokul7/Graphical-Password-Authentication-With-
Data-Hiding
• Engineered a 3-factor authentication framework combining username/password validation, graphical image verification, and
PIN-based authentication to strengthen resistance against credential-based attacks, monitoring login attempt patterns to
distinguish valid from suspicious access.
• Implemented AES encryption for secure file protection and integrated DWT-based steganography for hidden data embedding,
reducing exposure during file transfer.
• Designed and tested secure file upload, access-approval, and file-sharing workflows, validating correct rejection of unauthorized
access attempts across invalid and boundary input cases.
• Built a full-stack web application integrating authentication modules, encrypted storage, NumPy-based pixel-level image
processing, and database-driven user management.
• Maintained a structured, queryable log of authentication attempts and file-sharing events for traceability, verifying
encryption/decryption integrity across repeated test cycles with zero data loss.
• Published as a peer-reviewed paper, "Enhanced Security Framework: Graphical Password Authentication with Data Hiding on
Cloud Storage," in the International Journal of Advanced Research in Computer and Communication Engineering (IJARCCE),
Volume 14, Issue 4, April 2025. DOI: 10.17148/IJARCCE.2025.14481
4. Real Estate Management System — Team Project Apr 2024 – May 2024
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP , MySQL, XAMPP | github.com/Iamgokul7/Real-Estate-Management-System
• Built a full property management platform (team of 3) supporting listings, search/filtering, bookings, and inquiry workflows,
backed by a normalized MySQL schema with SQL joins for search, filtering, and reporting.
• Implemented user authentication and role-separated admin/customer modules, developing admin panels for managing
properties, feedback, and transaction records.
• Designed responsive interfaces across devices and conducted interface validation, cross-device testing, and MySQL data
consistency checks during team review cycles.
